--  Notes:- Removed Lower from natco_code as there is no value in caps
--  Internalemployee filter is always no only in whole dataset so removing additional filter
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
         DATE(event_date) AS dt
        ,session_id
		,action
		,label
		,page_name
		,order_id
        
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE 
        {{date}}
		 [[AND {{customer_type}}]]
		 
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
     --   AND lower(internalemployee) = 'no'
   --     AND natco_code = 'de'		
	  AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )	
        AND lower(category) <> 'addonmanagement'
		 			  		AND (
'All' IN ({{category}})
OR category = {{category}}
OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
)
		   [[ AND {{natco}} ]]
        
),
base_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        date_trunc(
            CASE 
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily'   THEN 'day'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly'  THEN 'week'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN 'month'
            END,
            dt
        ) AS period_sort,
        CASE 
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily' THEN
                format_datetime(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    format_datetime(date_trunc('week', dt), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                    ' -Wk',
                    CAST(week_of_year(dt) AS VARCHAR)
                )
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN
                format_datetime(date_trunc('month', dt), 'MMM-yyyy')
        END AS period,

        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%BASKET%' 
			AND LOWER(action) = 'pageview'
            THEN session_id 
        END) AS basket_page,
		COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN lower(action) = 'onecheckoutinitiated'  
            THEN session_id 
        END) AS ocbasket_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN lower(action) = 'purchasesuccess' 
            THEN session_id 
        END) AS order_placed
    FROM base
	GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 
    period,
    order_placed,
    basket_page,
    ocbasket_page,
    order_placed*1.0/NULLIF(basket_page,0)   AS basketconversion_percentage,
    order_placed*1.0/NULLIF(ocbasket_page,0) AS ocbasket_pageconversion_percentage
FROM base_agg
ORDER BY period_sort asc
